messages.schedule.archive.confirm: Archive this scheduled task? It won’t run automatically anymore, and its read permissions are revoked with it.
messages.schedule.directory.summary: Run scheduled conversation tasks and receive plugin reminders on time.
messages.schedule.form.help: When due, it runs a turn in this task’s own chat, not in an existing Coding session.
messages.schedule.form.instructions-hint: Read-only by default. File edits still go through the existing review queue.
messages.schedule.form.instructions-placeholder: Write what AI should check and report when this task is due…
messages.schedule.form.notify: Highlight in the list when an update is important
messages.schedule.form.once-hint: The time was set where this task was scheduled and can’t be changed here.
messages.schedule.form.reads: Once it’s created, choose here what it can read. Without a choice, it reads project files only.
messages.schedule.form.time-hint: Uses this computer’s local time. Alarms only fire while Molis Work is running.
messages.schedule.form.title: Title
messages.schedule.hint.model: No AI model is set up yet, so this task can’t run automatically when due. You can save it now and add a model in Settings › Models later.
messages.schedule.hint.workspace: This project has no folder linked yet, so AI can’t read project files when due. Save it now and add a folder in Project settings › Inputs and output later.
messages.schedule.job.identity-unverified: The original installation can’t be verified. Review the reminder and the current plugin before restoring it.
messages.schedule.job.install-first: Install and enable the corresponding plugin, then refresh to review it.
messages.schedule.list.empty-body: Schedule a time and AI will check and report back here automatically (read-only). Reminders created by other features also appear here.
messages.schedule.operation.changed: The task has changed. Return to the list and choose again.
messages.schedule.operation.gone: The original alarm or operation is missing. Keep the history and create a new schedule.
messages.schedule.operation.warning-resume: Assign the original operation and input to the current installation. Undispatched work waits for a fresh wakeup, then keeps the original interval. This confirmation allows plugin code to run.
messages.schedule.operation.warning-retry: The previous call may already have incurred costs or made external changes. Retrying runs the same input again and may duplicate those effects. Check the external records first.
messages.schedule.operation.warning-skip: Skip the earliest unknown occurrence without running it again. Review any remaining unknown outcomes, then continue at the original interval; a one-time task ends here.
messages.schedule.reads.created: Task created. Choose what it can read and the next run can use it.
messages.schedule.reads.failed: Can’t show what this task can read right now
messages.schedule.reads.failed-body: Permissions can’t be read right now. You can retry reading them. The task checks again when due; if it still can’t read them, that run fails.
messages.schedule.reads.needs-confirmation: One category can read more, or reads differently now. It can’t be read until you confirm it again.
messages.schedule.reads.none: None chosen; reads project files only
messages.schedule.reads.nothing-readable: None of the chosen categories can be read right now. It still runs when due and reports what it couldn’t read.
messages.schedule.reads.removed: One category is no longer offered, so this task can’t read it.
messages.schedule.reads.title: Data it can read
messages.schedule.reads.unavailable: One category’s plugin is turned off, so it can’t be read for now. The permission stays and comes back when the plugin is re-enabled.
messages.schedule.reads.workspace: Tasks that read project files need a linked project folder first.
messages.schedule.recovery.gone: This reminder has already been restored or no longer exists. Return to the list to check.
messages.schedule.recovery.note: Keep the original schedule. An overdue reminder is delivered once, then repeats at the original interval. This doesn’t run plugin code.
messages.schedule.recovery.title: Restore this reminder
messages.schedule.agent-role.reader.name: Read-only runner
messages.schedule.agent-role.brief.name: Read data and run
messages.schedule.read-group.operations.descripti: This project’s scheduled tasks and reminders, plus other plugins’ scheduled operations with their original input
messages.schedule.read-group.operations.title: Scheduled operations
messages.schedule.read-group.reminders.descriptio: This project’s reminders: what they say (including reminders other plugins set), which plugin set them, and when they’re next due
messages.schedule.read-group.reminders.title: Reminders
messages.schedule.help.title: Schedule
messages.schedule.help.what: Runs a recurring task at the time you set, saving results back to this project and sending externally only to recipients you named.
messages.schedule.help.example-1: Every Monday morning, turn meeting notes into a project report
messages.schedule.help.example-2: Every evening, summarize items waiting for your reply
messages.schedule.help.scope: Runs strictly within the permissions you granted and is billed by your model provider; pausing or revoking stops the next run and states why.
messages.schedule.help.advanced-summary: Time zone, missed runs, and pausing
messages.schedule.help.advanced: Uses this computer’s time zone; if the computer was asleep, it runs once on waking rather than replaying every missed slot.
messages.schedule.permission.storage-private.reas: Save this project’s scheduled tasks and reminders
messages.schedule.permission.schedule-read.reason: Read this project’s scheduled tasks and reminders
messages.schedule.permission.schedule-write.reaso: Create, edit, pause, and archive scheduled tasks
messages.schedule.permission.agent-run.reason: Run this project’s read-only scheduled conversation tasks on time
messages.schedule.permission.model-read.reason: Check whether a text model is ready for scheduled tasks
messages.schedule.permission.plugins-read.reason: Verify the installed plugin that owns each reminder or scheduled operation
messages.schedule.permission.actions-invoke.reaso: Run scheduled operations registered by plugins in this project
Deliver due reminders and task results to your inbox
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-list.title: List scheduled tasks
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-list.description: Lists active conversation tasks and plugin reminders in this project, excluding archived tasks. Can filter to tasks linked to a specific item.
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-list.title: List reminders
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-list.descript: Lists only this project’s reminders with their message, source plugin, next time, and enabled state.
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-readiness.title: Check task readiness
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-readiness.descrip: Checks whether a text model and project workspace are ready for scheduled tasks. Tasks can still be created if something is missing, but they’ll fail when due.
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-create.title: Create scheduled task
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-create.descriptio: Creates a scheduled conversation task and registers its next run so it runs automatically according to your instructions.
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-update.title: Update scheduled task
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-update.descriptio: Updates a task’s title, instructions, or time. Active tasks reschedule to the new time while keeping past conversation records.
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-archive.title: Archive scheduled task
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-archive.descripti: Stops a task, removes it from the active list, and cancels upcoming runs while keeping past records.
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-enabled.title: Pause or resume task
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-enabled.descripti: Pauses a task so it won’t run when due, or resumes it starting from the next upcoming slot.
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-open.title: Mark task as read
messages.schedule.actions.tasks-open.description: Clears the unread marker when you open a task without changing its schedule.
messages.schedule.actions.jobs-enabled.title: Pause or resume reminder
messages.schedule.actions.jobs-enabled.descriptio: Pauses or resumes reminders and scheduled jobs registered by other plugins. Conversation tasks use their own switch.
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-recover.title: Confirm and restore reminder
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-recover.descr: After you review the reminder and current plugin install, restores it to the current schedule and delivers once if overdue.
messages.schedule.actions.operations-recover.desc: Reviews the original operation, input, and history before you choose to restore its schedule, retry an unconfirmed run, or skip it.
messages.schedule.actions.search-entries.title: List searchable scheduled tasks
messages.schedule.actions.search-entries.descript: Lists project scheduled tasks in batches for search indexing. Read-only and doesn’t modify data.
messages.schedule.actions.subject-read.title: Read task details and links
messages.schedule.actions.subject-read.descriptio: Reads a scheduled task’s current instructions, version, and links for accurate reference.
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-add.title: Schedule reminder
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-add.descripti: Registers a reminder delivered to your inbox at a set time without running plugin code. Supports one-time, daily, or weekly reminders (up to 200 per plugin).
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-cancel.title: Cancel reminder
messages.schedule.actions.reminders-cancel.descri: Cancels a reminder created by the current plugin. Already delivered one-time reminders can’t be canceled.
messages.schedule.actions.schedules-add.title: Schedule recurring action
messages.schedule.actions.schedules-add.descripti: Schedules one of the current plugin’s actions to run on time, optionally sending results to Inbox (up to 20 per plugin). Unconfirmed runs aren’t retried automatically.
messages.schedule.actions.schedules-cancel.title: Cancel scheduled action
messages.schedule.actions.schedules-cancel.descri: Cancels a scheduled action created by the current plugin. Other plugins’ jobs or finished one-time runs aren’t affected.
messages.schedule.actions.task-wakeup.title: Run scheduled conversation task
messages.schedule.actions.task-wakeup.description: Wakes and runs this project’s scheduled conversation task when due.
messages.schedule.actions.reminder-wakeup.title: Deliver due reminder
messages.schedule.actions.reminder-wakeup.descrip: Delivers a due reminder to your inbox.
messages.schedule.actions.operation-wakeup.title: Run due plugin operation
messages.schedule.actions.operation-wakeup.descri: Runs a plugin’s scheduled operation when due.
messages.schedule.actions.runs-overview.title: Scheduled runs overview
messages.schedule.actions.runs-overview.descripti: Lists upcoming automatic runs and missed runs waiting for your choice. Read-only.
messages.schedule.actions.runs-decide.title: Handle missed scheduled run
messages.schedule.actions.runs-decide.description: Runs a missed scheduled task once now, or skips it.
